Clues 8, 2, 9, 11, 6 and 7 then place T, Q, S and M.
The chain fits into the row in only one way.

set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Linear seating
set.stimulus:
Nine persons, Asha, Chetan, Esha, Jyoti, Neha, Pooja, Suresh, Tarun and Wasim, sit in a straight row facing north, not necessarily in the same order.

1. Pooja sits third to the right of Neha.
2. Asha sits third to the left of Tarun.
3. Chetan does not sit at any of the extreme ends of the row.
4. Only one person sits between Asha and Neha.
5. Neither Chetan nor Neha is an immediate neighbour of Pooja.
6. Only one person sits between Suresh and Neha when counted from the right of Suresh.
7. Esha sits to the immediate right of the one who sits second to the right of Suresh.
8. Neither Pooja nor Tarun is an immediate neighbour of Wasim.

Clue 3 cannot be met in Case 2a and Case 2b, so they are rejected.
Clue 3 then places the next persons.
Jyoti takes the only seat left.
Final arrangement (west to east): Wasim, Suresh, Chetan, Neha, Esha, Asha, Pooja, Jyoti, Tarun.
Third to the right of Suresh: Chetan → Neha → Esha — answer **Esha**.
solution.shortcut: Take left/right from the person’s own facing, then count seats along the row.
